hangman.name: Hangman
hangman.blurb: Guess the word letter by letter.

rock-paper-scissors.name: Rock paper scissors
rock-paper-scissors.blurb: Play the computer, best of 3, 5 or 7.

hangman.a1: The word is shown as blanks. Guess one letter at a time: a right letter fills every blank it belongs in, a wrong one adds a part to the drawing. Fill the whole word before the sixth wrong guess finishes the figure.
hangman.q2: What is the best first guess?
hangman.a2: In English, start with E, then common letters such as A, T, O, I, N, S and R. Vowels quickly show the shape of a word.
hangman.a3: Hint shows one hidden letter and counts as one wrong guess. It is not offered when it would use your last guess or when only one letter is left.
hangman.q4: Can I play with a friend?
hangman.a4: Yes. One person types a secret word under Play with a friend (the field hides what is typed) and the other guesses. Words played this way do not count in your score.
hangman.a5: Word lists in English, Spanish and Indonesian, in six categories: animals, food, countries, sports, jobs and things at home. In Spanish, accents do not matter (A also finds Á) and Ñ has its own key.

rock-paper-scissors.q1: What are the rules of rock paper scissors?
rock-paper-scissors.a1: Rock crushes scissors, scissors cut paper and paper covers rock. Both players throw at the same time; the same throw is a draw.
rock-paper-scissors.a2: No. Its throw is drawn at random with your browser's cryptographic random number generator, and it never looks at your choice or your past throws.
rock-paper-scissors.q3: Is there a strategy that wins?
rock-paper-scissors.a3: Against a truly random player every throw wins a third of the time over many rounds. Against people, patterns help: many players repeat a winning throw and switch after a loss.
rock-paper-scissors.q4: What is Rock Paper Scissors Lizard Spock?
rock-paper-scissors.a4: A five-move version by Sam Kass and Karen Bryla. Each move beats two others and loses to two, so draws are rarer. Choose it under Rules.
rock-paper-scissors.q5: Can I play with the keyboard?
rock-paper-scissors.a5: Yes: R for rock, P for paper, S for scissors, and L for lizard and K for Spock in the five-move game.

bac-calculator.q1: How is blood alcohol content calculated?
bac-calculator.a1: With the Widmark formula: grams of alcohol divided by body weight in grams times a body water factor (0.68 for men, 0.55 for women), times 100, minus 0.015 for every hour since you started drinking.
bac-calculator.q2: How many drinks put me over 0.08?
bac-calculator.a2: It depends on weight, sex and time. About three U.S. standard drinks in one hour bring a 70 kg (155 lb) man close to 0.08 %; for a 60 kg (130 lb) woman, about two. Try your own numbers above.
bac-calculator.q3: How long does it take to sober up?
bac-calculator.a3: The body removes about 0.015 % BAC an hour, and nothing speeds it up: coffee, water, cold showers and sleep do not. The calculator shows the hours left until each level.
bac-calculator.q4: What do %, ‰ and mg/100 mL mean?
bac-calculator.a4: They are the same measure in different units. 0.08 % equals 0.8 ‰ (grams per litre) and 80 mg per 100 mL. Countries write their limits in different ones.
bac-calculator.q5: Can I use this to decide whether to drive?
bac-calculator.a5: No. It is an average-person estimate and real levels vary with food, health, medicines and how fast you drank. Limits differ by country and some are zero. If you have been drinking, do not drive.

simple-interest.q1: What is the simple interest formula?
simple-interest.a1: I = P × r × t: interest equals the principal times the yearly rate (as a decimal) times the time in years. The total to repay or receive is P + I.
simple-interest.q2: How do I find the principal, rate or time?
simple-interest.a2: Rearrange the formula: P = I ÷ (r × t), r = I ÷ (P × t) and t = I ÷ (P × r). Choose what to find and enter the other three.
simple-interest.q3: How are months and days counted?
simple-interest.a3: Months are divided by 12. Days are divided by 365, or by 360 if your loan uses the banker's year, which gives a little more interest for the same days.
simple-interest.q4: What is the difference between simple and compound interest?
simple-interest.a4: Simple interest is paid on the original principal only, so it grows by the same amount every year. Compound interest is also paid on earlier interest, so it grows faster. The table shows both side by side.
simple-interest.a5: Many car loans, short personal loans, bonds' coupon payments and some savings certificates. Mortgages and credit cards usually compound.

hangman.lead: Play a round of hangman in three steps.
hangman.s1b: Pick a language and a category, or type a secret word for a friend to guess.
hangman.s2b: Tap a letter or press it on your keyboard. Right letters fill the blanks; wrong ones add to the drawing.
hangman.s3b: Finish the word before six wrong guesses. Tap New word for the next round; your wins and streak add up.

rock-paper-scissors.lead: Play rock paper scissors against the computer in three steps.
rock-paper-scissors.s1b: Pick classic rules or Lizard Spock, and play single rounds or best of 3, 5 or 7.
rock-paper-scissors.s2b: Tap rock, paper or scissors, or press R, P or S. The computer throws at the same moment.
rock-paper-scissors.s3b: The page says who won and why, keeps the score and lists your last rounds.

bac-calculator.lead: Estimate your blood alcohol content in three steps.
bac-calculator.s1b: Choose sex, enter your weight and the hours since your first drink.
bac-calculator.s2b: Pick each drink and how many. Change the size or % alcohol to match the label.
bac-calculator.s3b: See your BAC in %, ‰ and mg/100 mL, and the time until it falls to each level. It is an estimate: do not drive after drinking.

simple-interest.lead: Work out simple interest in three steps.
simple-interest.s1b: Interest and total, or the principal, rate or time.
simple-interest.s2b: Type the principal, yearly rate, time (years, months or days) or interest, whichever are shown.
simple-interest.s3b: The result, the filled-in formula and a year-by-year table next to compound interest. Copy it with one tap.

hangman.title: Hangman
hangman.privacyNote: Guess the word one letter at a time before the drawing is finished.
hangman.lost: Out of guesses. The word was {word}.
hangman.secretBad: Use 2–30 letters; spaces and hyphens are fine, digits and symbols are not.
hangman.secretOk: Word set. Pass the device to the guesser.
hangman.tip: Tip: you can type letters on your keyboard. Vowels first shows the shape of the word.
hangman.pending: Your new choice starts with the next word. Tap New word to switch now.
hangman.newConfirm: Give up this word? Tap again

rps.title: Rock paper scissors
rps.privacyNote: Rock crushes scissors, scissors cut paper, paper covers rock.
rps.matchWon: You won the match! Matches: you {won}, computer {lost}.
rps.matchLost: The computer won the match. Matches: you {won}, computer {lost}.
rps.tip: Keys: R rock, P paper, S scissors (L lizard, K Spock). The computer throws at random and never sees your choice.

bac.title: BAC calculator
bac.privacyNote: An estimate of blood alcohol content with the Widmark formula. Not a breath test.
bac.b_none: About zero: the alcohol should be gone.
bac.b_mild: Below 0.05 %, but judgment and reactions already slip, and some countries' driving limits are 0.02 % or 0.03 %.
bac.b_impaired: Impaired: coordination, reaction time and judgment are clearly affected. Over the limit in most countries.
bac.b_heavy: Heavily drunk: balance, speech and memory suffer. Get help and do not drink more.
bac.b_danger: Dangerous: risk of alcohol poisoning. If someone is hard to wake, breathing slowly or vomiting while drowsy, call emergency services.
bac.invalid: Enter a body weight between 20 and 400 kg (44–880 lb) and the hours since the first drink.
bac.warning: This is an estimate for an average person, not a measurement. Food, health, medicines and how fast you drank change the real level, and legal limits differ by country (some are zero). Never use it to decide whether to drive.

simpleInterest.title: Simple interest calculator
simpleInterest.privacyNote: I = P × r × t. Find the interest, principal, rate or time.
simpleInterest.invalid: Enter non-negative numbers. Finding the principal needs a rate and a time above zero; the rate needs a principal and a time; the time needs a principal and a rate.
